scripts.build: rm -rf dist && for function in systems update-planets update-moons update-stars update-spaceships register-spaceship spaceship-info update-spaceship contacts-info contact-messages send-contact-message generate-contact-reply; do mkdir -p "dist/$function"; esbuild "src/functions/$function.ts" --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile="dist/$function/index.js"; (cd "dist/$function" && zip -q "../$function.zip" index.js); rm -rf "dist/$function"; done
